goal: 1.5x–3x same-workload committed Decode, drafts 2/3, unchanged exact target state/output
decision_unit: bounded numerical instruction feasibility; no performance authority
downward_trace: Retained v31 d2 complete Decode needs about 1.30/4.78 seconds less at 8K/40K. Its verifier costs 17.149/23.402 seconds. Prior real P40000 attribution identifies projections as dominant. A different executor would need to preserve the original FP32 chain at each step, not merely a BF16 input/output dtype.
hypothesis: Encode one nonzero BF16 product per MMA output and instruction, preserving each scalar chain's product order and FP32 carried accumulator. Independent output channels/chains could then map to Tensor Core output coordinates without a K reduction reassociation. This is distinct from the rejected multi-product certificate executors.
equivalence_gate: For one product, MMA(A,B,C) must reproduce fma.rn.f32(a,b,c), including ordinary finite values. Exact BF16 products alone do not prove identical accumulator rounding. NVIDIA PTX 8.5 leaves BF16 MMA accumulation rounding unspecified.

reference.scope: Official ISA numerical contract and already vendored BF16 instruction form; no code import or runtime dependency. Newer-device numerical studies do not establish SM87 semantics.

screen.ownership: One warp per fixed case; A[:,0]=a, B[0,:]=b, every other operand zero. All 128 outputs checked, plus guard bytes.
screen.cases: Exact-operation controls; finite normal rounding boundaries including a BF16-publication midpoint; a zero-start four-product chain using exactly representable FP8 weights and BF16 activations.
screen.oracles: Explicit GPU __fmaf_rn plus independent host std::fma and directed hexadecimal expected bits; compare FP32 and final BF16 outputs.
screen.budget: One synthetic numerical GPU process after build and recorded host/device preflight. No timing, local benchmark, profiler, geometry scan or full-model run if any ordinary finite counterexample exists.
screen.failure: A valid counterexample closes direct single-product MMA substitution. It does not establish a hardware speed ceiling or exclude a separately proved corrected computation.
screen.success: Passing finite samples is necessary but insufficient. A full exceptional-value/equivalence proof and a bounded native verifier composition with immediate real d2/d3 API return would still be required. No runtime selection from T1.

upward_return: Only an admitted complete executor may return through scalar-prefix state/logits and the same P65/8K/40K API panel with Prefill/TTFT/Decode/total and natural work accounting. Production, reserve and numerical baseline stay unchanged.
